objective: The Phoenix Flamingo's beak follows its head: its hanging beak was skinned to the body and tore away from its face whenever the head turned (its idle, attack and spell).
acceptance_criteria: Every vertex of the Phoenix Flamingo's beak follows its head bone; the base and King Flamingos are unchanged
The rebuilt model is uploaded and StationAssets names it
verification: Blender: the 30 frontmost vertices all follow the head (11 followed the body before); the flamingo's preen, neck lash and wing peck rendered on the rebuilt model keep the beak on the face. Studio: the Phoenix's lane in the walk-through.
notes: SHANNON, 2026-11-22: "they are all good except the pheonix flamingo has a slight beak issue". skin_forge's flamingo weights take a vertex as the head's only above the neck joint's height; the Phoenix's long beak hangs below it. `beak` (y -0.3 in its source's units) gives everything ahead of that to the head. The mesh and UVs are unchanged, so its texture and rainbow coat stay as uploaded.
